name: PB Fintech Ltd
about: PB Fintech Ltd, popularly known as Policy Bazar is India’s largest online platform for insurance and lending products through its flagship brands - Policybazaar and Paisabazaar platform through which they provide convenient access to insurance, credit and other financial products[1]
keyPoints: Business Model[1] PB Fintech runs an asset-light, digital-first model for distributing and servicing financial products. It does not underwrite insurance or carry lending risk on its own balance sheet. The Core Online business comprises Policybazaar and Paisabazaar. Distribution runs through three channels: B2C direct, B2B2C through POSP partners, and B2B corporate. The company covers the full customer lifecycle, from discovery and advice to the transaction, servicing, claims, and renewals.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 41.9% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's median sales growth is 46.1% of last 10 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 171 days to 68.1 days
cons: Stock is trading at 6.48 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.62% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.383 Cr.
